items.a: Yes — search, map view and filters are completely free, even without an account. An account is only needed for extras like the watchlist and saved searches.

items.q: Which countries does the data come from?
items.a: ZVG Scout crawls court and official portals across many European countries as well as curated sources in North America. You can see the exact country list in the search filters.

items.q: How up to date is the data?
items.a: A background crawler updates the data continuously — you don't need to trigger anything manually.

items.q: Does ZVG Scout replace legal advice?
items.a: No. ZVG Scout provides research data, not legal advice. The listing page lets you contact a referred lawyer directly if you need one.

items.q: What does the AI summary do?
items.a: It summarizes property data, location and condition from appraisals and listings, translating them if needed — on demand, right on the listing page.

items.q: Does the acquisition-cost calculator work for every country?
items.a: No, it currently only covers German foreclosure auctions.
